ℹ️How the ranks are worked out
  • All data is taken from the GSSC provisional result PDF (uploaded 23.11.2026). This is not an official GSSC rank list. Always check the official GSSC website.
  • Final score = Konkani + All other units, exactly as in the PDF. Only present candidates are ranked.
  • Candidates with the same score share the same rank (e.g. 1, 2, 2, 4). GSSC's own tie-breaking rules are not applied.
  • Each application ID is ranked separately, as in the PDF. A candidate who applied for more than one post may appear more than once.
  • Candidates marked * by GSSC gave two different categories; their category is to be verified, so they get an overall rank but no category rank.
